context.name: state-pilot-017
context.hypothesis: The binding failure is assertion under uncertainty, not evidence sparsity. Asking only for per-frame ball state and deriving events in code should raise precision substantially and eliminate contradictory labels, at a cost in recall.
context.declared_change: Output contract only. Identical dense frames from016 (same JPEG bytes), same model, temperature0, seed0, output cap1536, references, definitions and five-second one-to-one matcher. The model no longer names events.
context.derivation: Deterministic transitions in src/hypereel/evaluation/ball_state.py. A shot outcome requires an observed through_net, or observed rim_contact followed by observed possession. An unknown court zone yields no typed shot. A possession change is a turnover only with no shot in between. Every non-emission is recorded as a derivation note.
context.structural_properties: Mutually exclusive labels are impossible by construction. A scoreboard cannot produce an event because it is not in the vocabulary.
context.expected_cost: Recall is expected to fall. That is the declared trade and will be reported as a loss, not reframed.
context.controls: 016 dense direct and transcript arms on the identical images; 013 sparse direct across the same eight windows.
context.failures: No retries. Record the failed window; continue independent windows unless transport or budget failure.

prompt:
Report only what is VISIBLE in each of these ordered basketball images. Do not name events, do not read the scoreboard, do not infer anything hidden between images. Image timestamps in seconds: [20.0, 21.6, 23.2, 24.8, 26.4, 28.0]. Return JSON with exactly one key, frames, containing exactly one entry per image in order.
Each entry has exactly time_seconds (the supplied timestamp), ball_state, team and court_zone.
ball_state is exactly one of: held (a player is holding or dribbling the ball), in_flight (the ball is in the air after a shot or pass, untouched), rim_contact (the ball is visibly touching the rim or backboard), through_net (the ball is visibly passing down through the net), deflected (a defender visibly touches the ball during a shot), loose (the ball is free and no player controls it), not_visible (you cannot locate the ball).
team is the jersey colour of the team controlling or last touching the ball, lowercase, or unknown if you cannot tell.
court_zone is where the ball is: free_throw_line, inside_arc, beyond_arc, or unknown.
Use through_net ONLY if you can see the ball pass down through the net. Use rim_contact ONLY if you can see the ball touch the rim or backboard. If unsure between two states, choose not_visible or loose. Guessing is worse than unknown.
